title: Founding AI Engineer @handly - 20VC backed
description:
Germany has about a million trade businesses. They do more than €700 billion of work a year, and they run almost all of it by hand: quotes in the evening, invoices on the weekend, payments chased between jobs.
For decades, the software built for them was made for desk workers. Forms, menus, dropdowns, buttons. None of it was made for people who are always on the go and only care about the outcome.
AI changes that. For the first time, the admin of a trade business can be done for the owner instead of by them.
We are building a business-in-a-box for the trades .
Tradespeople want outcomes done for them , with as little interaction with software as possible. handly takes care of leads, quotes, measurements, invoicing and payments, so they can focus on their craft, and is accountable for the result.
We started with roofers in Germany. Other trades are next.
Delivering outcomes is a much harder problem than delivering software. That is the job of an AI-native services company. Most of our vision has not been built yet, and we are looking for top-tier talent in Berlin to help us bring it to life.
We are a small, close-knit team in Berlin-Mitte, backed by 20VC, Stride and Base10. We build, experiment and move fast, and we have found creative ways to use AI in every part of the company: product, ops, go-to-market and admin.

title: Product Manager, Design Systems
description:
About the role

We are hiring a Product Manager to join our AI & App Experience (AAX) team, with a focus on design systems. In this role, you’ll help shape the shared foundations that make it easier for teams across Chime to build consistent, intuitive, and high-quality member experiences.

You’ll own product strategy and execution for design-system capabilities that sit at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You’ll work across teams to understand where fragmented patterns, tooling, and workflows create friction, then turn those insights into scalable systems that improve both the quality of our app experience and the speed at which teams can build it.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $196,000 and up to $255,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to

• Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for design-system capabilities within AAX, connecting platform investments to meaningful improvements in Chime’s member experience.

• Partner closely with Design and Engineering to evolve shared components, patterns, tooling, and infrastructure that enable teams to build cohesive app experiences more efficiently.

• Identify high-leverage opportunities to improve how product teams discover, adopt, and contribute to Chime’s design system, balancing consistency with the flexibility teams need to innovate.

• Develop a deep understanding of the needs of internal product builders and translate those needs into clear product priorities, requirements, and measurable outcomes.

• Drive alignment across multiple product areas, helping teams make thoughtful tradeoffs when shared platform needs, individual product needs, and longer-term experience quality intersect.

• Establish success measures for the design system, using quantitative and qualitative signals to understand adoption, developer and designer effectiveness, experience consistency, and business impact.

• Help define how emerging AI capabilities can improve the way Chime teams design, build, and maintain app experiences, where relevant to the design-system strategy.

To thrive in this role, you have

• 8+ years of experience as a Product Manager.

• Product management experience owning complex products, platforms, or internal systems from strategy through execution in a technology environment.

• Experience working on design systems, developer platforms, UI frameworks, shared product infrastructure, or similarly horizontal capabilities used by multiple teams.

• A track record of translating ambiguous, cross-functional problems into a clear product strategy, prioritized roadmap, and measurable outcomes.

• Experience partnering deeply with Product Design and Engineering, with enough technical and design fluency to navigate component architecture, platform constraints, user experience tradeoffs, and implementation decisions.

• Experience driving adoption of a shared product or platform across multiple teams, including identifying user pain points and influencing stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

• Evidence of using data, research, and customer or internal-user feedback to prioritize investments and assess whether a product or platform is delivering meaningful value.

• Experience operating in environments where quality, consistency, scale, and speed all matter, and where product decisions require balancing near-term delivery with durable foundations.

 
A little about us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime-a financial technology company, not a bank*-on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Candidates must reside in Indonesia and have existing authorisation to work there**
About Us
Revalue is a carbon credit development platform focused on one of the planet’s most critical but complex challenges - seeing nature regenerated at a planetary scale.

Our mission is to design the most cutting-edge and trusted nature credits for our planet.

We are bringing together a world-class team - forestry experts, ecologists, applied AI scientists, software engineers, geospatial analysts, commercial specialists, economists, and more - to create the unique DNA required to reimagine nature credits.

About the role
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team within Platform Intelligence.

Platform Intelligence develops the data infrastructure, machine learning, geospatial pipelines, and technical systems behind Revalue's nature and carbon intelligence products. We turn scientific and analytical work into repeatable, reliable outputs: ingesting and validating Earth observation datasets, producing the analyses and baselines that underpin our carbon methodologies, designing monitoring systems, and running the cloud platform underneath.

This role is about moving from analytical and ML prototypes to production-grade systems. You will work closely with engineers, data scientists, and analysts to build data pipelines, productionise models, and improve reproducibility, making workflows maintainable, observable, and usable by others.

Some of the most important work is deciding what to build, how to model it, and where to draw boundaries. You will work with domain experts to make those decisions rather than simply implementing predefined specifications.

It is a hands-on role at the boundary between software engineering, data science, geospatial engineering, and cloud infrastructure. You will not be expected to lead scientific model development, but you will make sure the models run reliably in production.

Who we are looking for
Please note: Candidates must have existing authorisation to work in Indonesia.

A strong mid-level or senior individual contributor who can own delivery independently and turn complex technical workflows into stable production systems.

Key skills:

• Strong software engineering background. Design, interface, contract, data and domain modeling.

• Scientific programming background in any domain: geospatial, remote sensing, ML, signal/audio/vision, quant, simulation, bioinformatics. We care more about the pattern of experience rather than the specific domain: translating messy, abstract, real-world structures into correct data representations and transformations.

• Comfortable across stacks and tools: generalist disposition, able to pick up new languages/frameworks as our needs shift.

• Familiar with modern SWE practices and product-engineering: discovery, scoping, iterative and incremental delivery, comfortable operating in ambiguity.

Hard skills:

• Good engineering practice: testing, code review, CI/CD, modular design, documentation.

• Experience productionising analytical, data science, or ML workflows: turning exploratory code into reliable systems, with a working understanding of batch processing, reproducibility, monitoring, and deployment.

• Day-to-day work is in scientific Python. However, we weigh fundamentals and data aptitude above prior Python experience: if you have done this kind of work in C++, Scala, … , that counts.

• Cloud engineering experience, ideally on GCP and AWS, including designing and operating cloud-based data systems.

• A pragmatic mindset: knowing when to build carefully, when to simplify, and when to avoid unnecessary complexity.

Soft skills:

• Comfortable with high-visibility, shared-ownership, collaborative work: pairing on decisions, small trunk-based commits, and real-time feedback on work in progress.

• Comfortable running discovery sessions with domain experts before building.

title: Senior Manager, Security Operations - Detection Engineering & Incident Response
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As the Senior Manager of Security Operations, you will lead and scale Everpure's global Detection Engineering and Cloud Incident Detection & Response (CIDR) teams. You will own the mission of transforming SecOps into a proactive, intelligence-driven defense engine that measurably reduces risk across cloud, SaaS, infrastructure, and endpoint environments. Partnering closely with GRC, Infrastructure, Product Security, and Engineering leadership, you will establish operational work plans, detection standards, and response strategies that safeguard the Everpure Platform against sophisticated global threats.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

•
Direct Detection Engineering & Incident Response Strategy: Establish operational objectives, work plans, and SLAs across threat detection, automated response workflows, and incident triage to continuously optimize Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).

•
Champion Threat-Informed Detection & Validation: Lead the deployment and continuous refinement of a high-signal detection inventory mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, validating control efficacy through automated simulations, red/purple team exercises, and threat hunt findings.

•
Streamline Telemetry Ingestion & Automation: Oversee the architectural ingestion of multi-cloud (AWS, Azure), endpoint, network, and SaaS log sources into SIEM and SOAR pipelines, reducing false positives and accelerating automated remediation.

•
Lead Executive Incident Governance & Postmortems: Direct major incident response efforts, oversee root-cause analyses, and translate complex security metrics into actionable executive dashboards and board-level risk reports that drive cross-functional remediation.

•
Manage & Develop SecOps Engineering Teams: Direct resource allocation, budget priorities, and professional development across multiple specialized security squads, cultivating a high-performing team culture focused on operational excellence.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

•
SecOps & Incident Leadership Expertise: Proven track record of leading and scaling enterprise security operations, detection engineering, and incident response functions across hybrid cloud and SaaS environments.

•
Advanced Technical & Telemetry Mastery: Deep technical command of SIEM and SOAR platforms, EDR solutions, cloud telemetry architectures, and detection-as-code principles integrated with modern CI/CD pipelines.

•
Threat Modeling & Governance Savvy: Comprehensive mastery of threat-informed defense methodologies, MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping, and control validation through atomic testing and threat hunting.

•
Executive Communication & Cross-Functional Influence: Demonstrated ability to interact with executive leadership, navigate complex risk discussions with Infrastructure and Engineering teams, and align technical posture with business priorities.

• Analyze data from mock conversions, validate load performance, and confirm that converted data supports go-live operations.

Prelim builds digital account-opening infrastructure for community banks and credit unions. We've sustained over 100% ARR growth for four consecutive years on seed funding, and our platform sits in the critical path of how banks onboard their customers. We're a small team. You'd be our first dedicated DevOps hire, which means you'll own infrastructure end to end.
What you'll own

• Own the build, test, and deploy pipeline. Our engineers ship fast; your job is to make shipping fast and safe: progressive rollouts, fast rollbacks, deploy confidence.

• Make and enforce our infrastructure as fully reproducible environments via code.

• Define and hit uptime targets our bank customers contractually depend on. Build out monitoring, alerting, and incident response so we find problems before our customers do. Mature our on-call practice from heroics into a system.

• We sell to regulated financial institutions. Change management, access controls, and audit logging need to produce evidence, not just exist. You'll partner closely with our security function on our ongoing SOC 2 and bank due-diligence requirements.

• Own the cloud bill. Growth shouldn't mean linear infrastructure spend.

What we're looking for

title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
description:
WHY BACKEND ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

- Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals - and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

- Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

- Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

- Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR INFRASTRUCTURE

- From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution https://langfuse.com/blog/2024-12-langfuse-v3-infrastructure-evolution - deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

- Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NXYQ5odATrM - recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

- Architecture https://langfuse.com/handbook/product-engineering/architecture

- Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

- You get excited when working with a ton of data

- Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.
GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Privacy & Data Sharing Specialist will work as part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.
The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and administering data privacy, classification, retention, and data-sharing policies across the CMM data platform, ensuring that sensitive and court-related data is protected, properly classified, and shared only under appropriate agreements and controls.
The Privacy & Data Sharing Specialist will execute the following responsibilities:

• Support analysis of systems, programs, and/or planning activities related to data privacy and data sharing across the CMM program.

• Perform research in support of privacy policies, procedures, and other technical documentation, and support analysis of data governance and data-sharing programs and initiatives.

• Research and analyze options to develop relationships and solutions that resolve data privacy and data-sharing problems within the specialty area.

• Analyze privacy- and data-related technical problems and provide engineering and technical support in solving them.

• Design, develop, engineer, and implement solutions that meet data privacy and data-sharing requirements.

• Perform privacy risk analyses (e.g., Privacy Impact Assessments) of computer systems and applications during all phases of the system development life cycle.

• Establish and satisfy complex system-wide data privacy and classification requirements based on the analysis of user, policy, regulatory, and resource demands.

• Support customers in the development and implementation of data privacy and data-sharing policies.

• Define and maintain data classification, retention, and handling rules for sensitive, court-related, and personally identifiable information (PII).

• Draft, review, and administer data sharing agreements, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), and interconnection security agreements (ISAs) with external agencies and partners.

• Partner with data governance, legal, and engineering teams to ensure data-sharing practices comply with the Privacy Act, court rules, and other applicable federal regulations.

• Maintain a data sharing inventory and monitor ongoing agreements for renewal, compliance, and risk.

• Advise program stakeholders on privacy-by-design principles for new data platform, reporting, and analytics capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

• BS/BA degree with 5+ years of experience of general experience in information systems providing enterprise cybersecurity through policy, architecture, and training processes.

• Experience developing plans to safeguard sensitive data against accidental or unauthorized modification, destruction, or disclosure.

• Experience working with Agile teams and SAFe, responding to security assessments, and providing oversight of vulnerability audits and assessments.

• Experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
TL;DR:
Lovable's mobile app (React Native, iOS/Android, owned by Team Everywhere) mirrors the web app's accounts/projects/credits while adding native login, push notifications, in-app top-ups, and haptics - it's one of the fastest-growing ways builders reach Lovable. The role is a product-minded fullstack engineer to own end-to-end mobile slices: native flows, auth, push, the web-native bridge, and app store ops (TestFlight, Play Console, compliance) across the full stack.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- At least 6 years of relevant experience at high-pace, high-scale companies

- Strong fullstack background: deep comfort with TypeScript/React on the frontend and Node.js or similar on the backend

- Hands-on experience with React Native in production, including native module integration.

- Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review/compliance cycles (Sign in with Apple, IAP, Android policy review)

- Product instinct: you think in user outcomes, not just API endpoints

- Comfort working with third-party services and building clean abstractions over vendor APIs. Familiarity with managed cloud services (AWS, GCP) and the tradeoffs of buy-vs-build

- Experience with push notification infrastructure or native device integrations is a strong plus

- You've shipped features in fast-moving, high-ownership environments where you wore multiple hats

What you’ll do

- Build and own native mobile features end-to-end: onboarding, auth, push notifications, in-app purchases/credit top-ups, and share targets

- Improve the web-native bridge that connects the in-app WebView experience to native device capabilities (keyboard handling, haptics, camera, file sharing)

- Own App Store and Play Store submissions, review compliance, and release tooling (TestFlight, Play Console, Fastlane)

- Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues (cold start, preview loading, crash handling) across iOS and Android

Our Tech Stack
We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable software engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:

- Mobile: React Native, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin

- Frontend: React and Typescript

- Backend: Golang and Rust

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Firebase

- Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery

- DevOps & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Kubernetes, Terraform, Fastlane

And always on the lookout for what's next!

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer (Java), mid to senior level, to join the Metadata Platform DB team. The Team

Metadata Platform DB owns Postgres provisioning and infrastructure as code, along with a set of Java (and one Rust) components built around it, including a core client library, a database proxy, a schema management tool, and a fork of an open-source sharding solution.

The Tech Stack

• Cloud Infrastructure: Cloud-native platform, expanding beyond current AWS and Azure dependencies toward provider-agnostic deployment.

• Core Technologies: Java, Postgres.

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, a Go-based operator.

• Systems components: Rust (database proxy).

• Containerization: Kubernetes.

• DevOps: Kustomize, GitHub CI, ArgoCD/Kargo, Datadog for metrics/logs/APM.

The Work You'll Do

• Take ownership of one or more Java components in the Postgres ecosystem, including newly onboarded ones.

• Work alongside the infrastructure-as-code side of the stack (Terraform, operators) to understand how your components are provisioned and operated.

• Improve reliability, performance, and security of the components you own.

• Where applicable, maintain forks of open-source projects - tracking upstream changes and making deliberate calls about merging versus diverging.

• Collaborate with teams handing off components and with downstream consumers.

• Document processes, concepts, and decisions as ownership transitions and components evolve.

The Qualifications You Need

• Solid professional experience building Java applications (3+ years mid-level, 7+ years senior).

• Experience with infrastructure and IaC concepts - comfort working with or alongside Terraform or similar provisioning tooling.

• Experience building, packaging, and debugging applications in containerized and Kubernetes environments (Docker/OCI).

• Experience with databases (Postgres preferred over InnoDB/MySQL, with a good grasp of Postgres MVCC and concurrency mechanics from an application perspective) and distributed systems.

• Experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests.

• Strong communication skills in English and a passion for clean, maintainable code.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Rust or Go.

• Experience maintaining a fork of an open-source project.

• Hands-on Terraform experience.

• Experience with monitoring and log analysis tools (e.g., Datadog).

• Familiarity with agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex).

What Celonis can offer you:

title: Assistant Vice President OR Senior Underwriter, Global Agriculture Reinsurance
description:
Skyward Specialty is a rapidly growing specialty Property & Casualty insurance carrier headquartered in Houston, Texas. We deliver tailored solutions across nine specialized underwriting divisions, with a culture grounded in deep technical expertise, decisive underwriting, and long-term broker and client relationships. Our Global Agriculture division underwrites a worldwide portfolio of agriculture reinsurance, partnering with cedants and reinsurance brokers across multiple territories to support food and farm economies through thoughtfully structured treaty solutions.
Position Summary
The Assistant Vice President OR Senior Underwriter, Global Agriculture Reinsurance is a senior technical underwriting role responsible for supporting, expanding, maintaining, and managing Skyward's global portfolio of agriculture reinsurance. The role underwrites and prices new and renewal treaty submissions, shapes portfolio strategy, and represents Skyward in the reinsurance market with brokers and ceding company clients.
This is a high-authority individual-contributor position for a proven (re)insurance professional who is at their best evaluating complex treaty business, forming a defensible technical view of risk, and building durable broker and client relationships. The role can be filled at the Senior Underwriter or Assistant Vice President level depending on the candidate's experience and underwriting authority. It reports to the Head of Global Agriculture and partners closely with Actuarial, Claims, Finance, and Accounting.
Key Responsibilities

• Perform in-depth technical underwriting and analysis of treaty reinsurance business across the global agriculture portfolio, including proportional and non-proportional structures.

• Underwrite and price new and renewal agriculture reinsurance submissions, applying delegated underwriting authority and pricing methodologies appropriate to crop, livestock, and related agricultural risks.

• Review primary policy forms, reinsurance contract wording, and endorsements to confirm coverage intent, terms, and conditions are accurately reflected and aligned with Skyward's risk appetite.

• Evaluate exposure, loss history, accumulation, and program structure to form a clear, defensible technical view of each opportunity.

• Provide support for strategic planning and ongoing management of the global agriculture portfolio, including profitability monitoring, portfolio construction, and renewal strategy.

• Market, develop, and maintain strong broker and ceding-client relationships, representing Skyward in the market and at industry events.

• Monitor market development and explore trends and cycles in agriculture reinsurance, translating those insights into actionable recommendations.

• Partner with Accounting, Finance, Claims, and Actuarial on monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting and on reserving and planning processes.

• Serve as a senior technical resource to analysts and less-experienced team members, contributing to underwriting guidelines, pricing tools, and best practices (AVP level).

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in agricultural economics, finance, risk management, actuarial science, mathematics, or a related field; advanced degree or professional designations (CPCU, ARe, ACAS/FCAS, or similar) a plus.

• Seven or more years of (re)insurance experience, with a meaningful portion in agriculture, treaty reinsurance, or a closely related specialty line; calibrated toward the AVP end for candidates with broader portfolio or market-facing exposure.

• Demonstrated treaty underwriting and pricing experience, including familiarity with proportional and non-proportional structures.

• Working knowledge of agriculture insurance and reinsurance products and the global agriculture risk landscape.

• Strong command of reinsurance contract and policy wording and the ability to identify coverage and structural issues.

• Proficiency with pricing and exposure analysis tools and strong Excel skills;

title: Solutions Consultant (UK)
description:
🚀 Turn your technical expertise into commercial impact.
What if you could combine your technical expertise with the excitement of winning the deal?
We’re looking for an experienced, commercially minded Solutions Consultant to join Huble ’s UK New Business team. This is an opportunity for a technically credible solutions professional who knows how to get under the skin of a customer’s challenges, design the right solution, and confidently take an opportunity from first conversation through to signed contract.
On-target earnings of up to 1.8x base salary, through an uncapped commission structure tied to individual revenue targets.
You won’t be sitting on the sidelines of the sales process. You’ll own your own number, own your opportunities and own the outcome.
Working with HubSpot at the centre of the solution, you’ll lead complex conversations across CRM, integrations, migrations, data, configuration and change management. You’ll run discovery, shape solutions, build proposals and commercials, present to senior stakeholders, negotiate terms and close deals - bringing in our expert consulting teams when deeper technical or delivery input is needed.
And because many of our opportunities come through HubSpot referrals, partner relationships, invitations and competitive RFPs , this isn’t a role built around endless cold outbound. It’s about being credible enough technically, commercially sharp enough to win, and personable enough to become a trusted advisor.
🖇️What you'll be doing
You’ll take ownership of opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, including:

• Running discovery and chemistry meetings to understand business challenges, goals and requirements.

• Designing and articulating HubSpot-led solutions across CRM, integrations, migrations and adjacent technologies.

• Taking the lead on technical conversations and answering architectural questions confidently, without needing a Solutions Architect on every call.

• Building compelling proposals, presentations, commercials and Statements of Work.

• Demonstrating HubSpot and the wider solution architecture to prospective customers.

• Clearly explaining how solution decisions and changes affect scope, pricing and delivery.

• Applying Time & Materials and Fixed Price commercial models appropriately.

• Negotiating commercial and contractual terms through to signature.

• Responding quickly and intelligently to RFPs and tenders.

• Working closely with our consulting, technology and leadership teams to turn client requirements into accurate quotes and SOWs at pace.

• Managing your pipeline, forecasts and activity with the commercial discipline needed to hit - and exceed - your sales target.

• Building relationships with Huble ’s strategic partners, including HubSpot, Aircall, DealHub, Sinch and Demandbase, to create and win opportunities together.

• Developing opportunities through referrals, existing relationships, partner networks and your own professional network.

👀The kind of person we're looking for
You might currently be a Solution Architect, Senior Solution Architect, Presales Consultant, Solutions Consultant or Solutions Engineer who is ready to take greater commercial ownership.
Perhaps you’ve built your career within a HubSpot, Salesforce or Dynamics partner consultancy and have already developed a strong understanding of how technology, consulting and commercial outcomes come together.
Or you may come from a complex B2B SaaS, CRM or MarTech environment - perhaps RevOps, ABM, intent data, CDP or integration technology - and have the technical credibility and customer-facing experience to move into a broader solutions-selling role.
The important thing is that you're not purely a technical specialist.
You understand that great solutions have to work commercially as well as technically. You’re comfortable owning a number, running a deal, talking about money, negotiating terms and ultimately asking for the business.

description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life-whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The AI Research team at Figma is working on the cutting edge of AI and Design. We work on optimizing agentic systems for design quality and end user experience. We build robust evaluators for Design and post-train models. We are a very collaborative, close-knit and impact-focused team of researchers and research engineers working on some of the most challenging technical problems at the intersection of AI and creativity.

We are seeking PhD interns with expertise in machine learning and artificial intelligence to develop innovative AI solutions for design and creative products. Through both fundamental and applied research, your work will contribute to new AI-driven features in Figma products.

This internship can take place in Winter 2027 or Summer 2027 in San Francisco or New York. 

What you’ll do at Figma:

• Drive fundamental and applied research in Generative AI with Figma product use cases in mind

• Formulate and implement new modeling approaches both to improve the effectiveness of Figma’s current AI models as well as enable the launch of entirely new AI-powered product features

• Explore the boundaries of what is possible with the current technology set and experiment with novel ideas

• Depending on your project, you may have the opportunity to publish your research in leading AI/ML conferences

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

• Are a 4th or 5th year senior Ph.D student in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Human Computer Interaction or a related field

• Proven expertise in AI through publications on recent advancements in AI, such as Large Language Models or Agentic systems

• Track record in applying machine learning techniques to projects in academia or industry

• Experience in Python and machine learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, TensorFlow)

• Experience solving sophisticated problems and comparing alternative solutions, trade-offs, and diverse points of view to determine a path forward

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

• Related industry experience via a past internship or full-time role

• Experience communicating your solutions effectively to different audiences

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to write, debug, and optimize code

At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Internship

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen. Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 ( Kijimea Reizdarm ). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert - u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet . Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. title: Tech Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As our organisation continues to grow, attracting the best talent remains one of our highest priorities. title: Senior Compute Infrastructure Engineer
description:
• About StackYak

StackYak is building the infrastructure layer for AI.
We are an early-stage, funded company building software that brings compute, GPU infrastructure, networking, and inference together into one product. The opportunity is large, the market is moving quickly, and we are building for real production workloads from the start.
This is not internal IT. This is not a slow-moving infrastructure team maintaining someone else's platform. The infrastructure is the product .
We are a small, senior team with very little bureaucracy. This is a founding role in its discipline. You will be the first person here whose primary responsibility is the systems layer beneath the product, and the shape it takes will largely be yours to decide.
Treat this document as a starting point rather than a boundary. The people who do well here take ground early and are not asked to give it back.
We move quickly. We do not have months for someone to learn the fundamentals of their discipline. You should already be very good at what you do, be able to ramp into adjacent areas quickly, and be comfortable operating without perfect requirements or neatly defined boundaries.
The Role
We need someone who knows what stands between GPU capacity and production infrastructure , and can build it.
That capacity does not arrive in one form. Some of it comes as hardware, with everything that implies: firmware, drivers, hosts, and physical work carried out by people you will never meet in buildings you will rarely visit. Some of it comes from neoclouds and other providers, where you control the software and very little else, on terms set by someone whose interests are not yours.
The interesting problem is neither of those on its own. It is the gap between them - how much of it can honestly be abstracted away, how much has to stay visible, and how much the rest of the company should ever have to think about. Those are open questions here, and the person in this role is the one who gets to answer them.
You should be comfortable at both ends. On one side: Linux, kernel, firmware, drivers, virtualization, host hardening, and debugging a machine you cannot walk up to. On the other: provider APIs, capacity that is not permanent, and automation at a scale where nothing gets configured by hand.
Workloads will run on bare metal, in VMs, and in containers. The right answer will not be the same one twice, and choosing is part of the job.
This is not an architecture-only role. You will design systems and then build, debug, and operate them.
What You Will Own
Not tasks. Outcomes, and the authority that comes with them.

• What the fleet is. What we own versus what we rent, where we standardise and where we deliberately do not, and what it costs us either way.

• The machines themselves. Linux, kernel, firmware, drivers, CUDA and/or ROCm - down to the layer where the answer lives in a changelog rather than documentation.

• Bare metal, VM, or container. You own the boundary between them, and the uncomfortable fact that the right answer will not be the same one twice.

• Isolation. What we claim about keeping customers and workloads apart, and whether that claim survives someone attacking it.

• Provisioning and recovery. A machine goes from nothing to serving, and from broken back to serving, without you personally being involved.

• Provider integration. Neoclouds and other compute vendors: what each of them actually gives you as opposed to what they advertise, and the seams that difference creates.

• Physical reality. Specifying hardware, and getting it from a purchase order to a booting machine through vendors, data-center partners, and remote hands you have never met.

• Failures that cross layers , where the cause could be hardware, firmware, OS, virtualization, storage, or network, and nobody else wants to own the question.

• Making it operable by other people , so the fleet does not quietly become a collection of one-off machines only you understand.

title: Biorepository Technician II
description:
Position Summary:

The Biorepository Technician II will perform with a high degree of accuracy and quality a variety of laboratory-related activities including cryopreservation of biological samples that arrive daily in the repository. This position requires skills in data reconciliation and using the reporting features of the BSI. 

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

Data Reconciliation:

• Investigate and resolve data discrepancies in conjunction with project collaborators

• Prepare and analyze reports from the BSI to identify possible errors in data

• Verify discrepancies noted by Lab Assistants during withdrawal or inventory procedures

• Complete Investigation tasks in specimen requisitions

Monitoring of freezers:

• Respond to freezer alarms in accordance with standard operating procedures

• Monitor freezers, refrigerator and room temperatures as assigned by Manager

Receive biological samples: 

• Unpack specimens and record all pertinent information in Incoming Shipment Batch and incoming folder

• Create a folder to house all associated paperwork

• Store at appropriate temperature following guidelines set by procedures

• Distribute confirmation of shipment receipt form if required by project

Receive supplies into inventory: 

• Verify shipment contents against packing list

• Quarantine Raw Materials for release by QA department

Inventory of Frozen Biological Samples:

• Utilize Quality Control Vials to estimate volume of frozen samples

• Check information on sample vial against information provided by the study site

• Scan samples into data management system, BSI

• Correct paperwork where necessary and inform supervisor/manager of any discrepancies by generating a discrepancy report

• Assist in the inventory of returned specimens

• Aliquot frozen specimens utilizing aseptic technique

Retrieve Frozen Samples from Inventory and Ship:

• Pull samples according to requisition, SOP, and instructions

• Perform quality control verification of outgoing samples

• Update Outgoing Batch Record

• Contact receiving labs prior to shipment to confirm shipping address and ensure contact will be available to receive specimens

• Ship samples (dangerous and non-dangerous goods) by Commercial or local courier

• Complete all paperwork (link-up forms, aliquot forms, return forms or BSI data collection sheets and any other forms which may be necessary)

Miscellaneous:

• Perform annual competency assessments for Repository staff

• Label vials and shipping boxes

• Perform dry shipper QC

• Coordinate and execute the quarterly temporary freezer inventory

• Coordinate Repository Equipment preventative maintenance

• Keep current on IATA Shipping Regulations and maintain certification and standards

• Carry out other duties/projects as assigned

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

• High School Diploma or equivalent combination of education and experience

• 2 years’ of general working experience

Other Required:

• Must possess basic laboratory skills

• Experience in written and verbal communications and a strong documentation background in a laboratory setting with respect to regulatory requirements (cGMP, cGLP or ISO) and Standard Operating Procedures

• Current knowledge of IATA Shipping Regulations and maintenance of certification and standards

• Requires good attention to detail, excellent documentation skills and must work well in a group environment

• Familiarity with excel and basic functions with the program

• Must be a flexible agile team player who can change activities and directions quickly and respond to a variety of assignment and changing business needs

• Ability to lift and carry between 31-50 lbs.; Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. overhead with assistance; frequently required to sit, stand and walk for prolonged periods; occasionally required to squat, bend, stoop, push, kneel, reach and perform tasks with repetitive motion; Will be exposed to a cold freezer

We're building something that helps real people solve real problems-and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

- Turning missed opportunities into new customers and growing active pipeline

- Strengthening CRM data and lost-lead processes across the revenue team

- Building a repeatable playbook for lead revival that the whole team can use

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Strong communication skills with a professional, persistent, and friendly approach

- Ability to follow structured processes and keep accurate records in a CRM

- Comfort reaching out to dormant or previously lost prospects with confidence and patience

- High organization, with the ability to manage multiple follow-up threads at once

- Enthusiasm for learning SaaS products, sales fundamentals, and customer engagement techniques

- Willingness to seek coaching, apply feedback, and share what works with the team
